cl.title: Calls to make

cl.empty: Nothing here. A call lands in this list when an order needs a person to phone the customer.
cl.cardReadOnly: Changing this needs the risk rules permission.
cl.pairHelp: Write each outcome's name in both English and Bengali.

err.STALE: Someone saved this card while you were looking. It has been loaded again — check it and save once more.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something here is not valid. Check the marked field.
err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to change this.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in ended. Sign in again.
err.other: It could not be saved. Try again.

nc.d: A customer with no earlier order anywhere in the shop — not by this number, the account or the same person under another number — gets one call on the first order. Never a hold, a decline or an advance; it adds nothing to the risk score.
nc.prepaidHelp: Off: only orders paid at the door get the call (a paid order needs no call).

oc.d: What a person can record after a call. Rename them in both languages, and tick the ones that close the call.
oc.done: These close the call (the others keep it for the next try)
